current_activity: LXXXII Corps throws all its security troops at the US 90th Division bridgehead on the Moselle north of Thionville
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 8 p. 401: "On 11 November the LXXXII Corps pulled all security troops, except one battalion, away from the Moselle north of the 90th Division bridgehead and threw them in to face the American attack". Event definition: the corps action of 11 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Thionville with a precision of 10 km; the bridgehead was on the Moselle north of the town. Location approximate: a town point. Location support: CMH names the Moselle bridgehead and Thionville in the chapter. Commander: General der Infanterie Johann Sinnhuber. Opponents: US XX Corps (90th Infantry Division).
